column1: # Accepted benchmark bands for the micro and gate batteries.
# `battery-check` compares against the `:median` rows only; repeat rows
# are recorded but never checked, so baselines use `<cell>:median` names.
# Long format, one row per cell+metric. `battery-check` fails when a
# reported value falls outside [baseline - band, baseline + band], where
# band = max(abs_tol, abs(baseline) * rel_tol). `n/a` counts as outside
# the band for a recorded metric.
#   cell      battery cell id: <level>-<profile> or its `:median`
#   baseline  accepted value, in the report's unit
#   rel_tol   relative band as a fraction (0.25 = +/-25%)
#   abs_tol   absolute band floor, in the report's unit
#   recorded  date or commit the value was accepted on
#   note      why the band is what it is
